title: Udin Din Din Dun
blurb: Pure rhythmic nonsense, assembled from repeated syllables and an unreasonable amount of confidence. It functions exactly the way a nursery rhyme does — the meaning is irrelevant and the cadence performs the entire job — which is why it moved through the brainrot canon so quickly and why nobody involved can tell you what it refers to. The percussive shape is doing something genuinely clever with stress patterns, whether or not anyone intended it. Play it once and it will loop in your head until roughly dinner time. Apologies are offered in advance.
